title: Hearing on citizen enforcement of idling and noise complaints
summary: The Council's Environmental Protection and Waterfronts Committee held an oversight hearing on citizen enforcement programs, including the Citizen Air Complaint Program and the Citizen Noise Complaint Program, alongside several related bills. The bills would raise idling penalties, translate the air complaint portal into more languages, revise rules for citizen complaints and recidivism tracking, let vehicle lessees be held liable for idling violations, create a code of conduct for noise complainants and add idling violations to the city's Fleet Program. Citizen air idling complaints rose from about 9,000 in 2019 to over 163,000 in 2025, while noise complaints dropped sharply after a 2024 law cut financial rewards for complainants.
